words.definition: the state of being extremely poor

sentence.sentence: The government has launched a program to eradicate poverty.
sentence.translation: सरकार ने गरीबी को समाप्त करने के लिए एक कार्यक्रम शुरू किया है।

sentence.translation: गरीबी कई विकासशील देशों में एक प्रमुख मुद्दा है।

words.definition: a state of not being equal

sentence.translation: सरकार को वंचित समूहों को सहायता प्रदान करनी चाहिए।

sentence.sentence: The organization is working to empower marginalized groups.

words.definition: the act of taking something away from someone

sentence.sentence: The organization is working to reduce deprivation of essential services.

sentence.sentence: The government should work to reduce inequitable practices in the workplace.

sentence.sentence: The government should work to reduce underdevelopment in marginalized communities.

words.definition: the act of separating someone or something

words.definition: the state of being on the edge of society

sentence.sentence: The marginality of certain groups is a major concern.

sentence.sentence: The government should work to reduce marginality in rural areas.
sentence.translation: सरकार को ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में हाशियापन को कम करने के लिए काम करना चाहिए।
